_comment: Hand-curated sideboard hoser catalog for Legacy. Each entry maps to a HoserCard in advisory/sideboard.py. swing: 'dedicated' = 0.20, 'soft' = 0.10. colors: WUBRG single-char list; empty = colorless. castable_any_color: true bypasses the color pre-filter (Phyrexian mana, free-activation abilities).

hosers.name: Surgical Extraction
hosers._comment: Phyrexian mana: castable for 2 life in any deck regardless of color identity.

hosers.name: Faerie Macabre
hosers._comment: Free discard activation: usable at zero mana cost in any deck.

hosers.name: Dauthi Voidwalker
hosers._comment: Exiles cards from graveyards as they go there; creature body provides additional pressure.

hosers.name: Consign to Memory
hosers._comment: Counters spells regardless of protection or hexproof; can counter multiple spells in a storm chain.

hosers.name: Veil of Summer
hosers._comment: Counter-hoser: defends the deck against opposing interaction.

hosers.name: Force of Vigor
hosers._comment: Answers Blood Moon / Back to Basics / Chalice.

hosers.name: Chalice of the Void
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact — always castable. Anti-synergy: blocked for low-curve decks.

hosers.name: Engineered Explosives
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact; sunburst lets it answer permanents at any CMC. Flexible removal vs Elves, Humans, tokens, lock pieces.

hosers.name: Sheoldred's Edict
hosers._comment: Edict effect that bypasses hexproof/indestructible by making opponent sacrifice; hits creature-based strategies.

hosers.name: Toxic Deluge
hosers._comment: One-sided board wipe that bypasses indestructible; scales CMC to handle any size threats.

hosers.name: Harbinger of the Seas
hosers._comment: Lands opponents control that aren't Islands don't untap — locks Tron and Cloudpost out of their mana.

hosers.name: Damping Sphere
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact. Nonbasic, non-island lands produce only {C}; each additional spell costs {1} more — hoses Tron/Post mana AND storm chains.

hosers.name: Pithing Needle
hosers._comment: Colorless artifact. Names Eye of Ugin / Eldrazi Temple activated abilities; staxes planeswalkers and utility lands.

hosers.name: Null Rod
hosers._comment: Shuts down mana artifacts (Mox Diamond, Chrome Mox, Grim Monolith) common in Eldrazi and Cloudpost shells.
